title: Uninsured Discount on an Insured Patient's Non-Covered Services — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
On an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account of a patient class whose schedule grants the uninsured discount on an insured patient's non-covered services, the non-covered amounts a payer released to the patient receive one uninsured discount adjustment. The adjustment is sourced to the account's most recent non-covered-service liability posting by posting date (of two posted on the same day, the one recorded first), and this rule fixes its amount. The account receives that adjustment once, and a non-covered-service posting recorded after it stands receives no further uninsured discount.

## Scope of the uninsured discount on insured accounts

- On an insured account, non-covered-service liability postings receive an uninsured discount only on patient classes whose schedule grants the uninsured discount on an insured patient's non-covered services, in the one adjustment and at the amount this rule fixes; deductible, coinsurance and copay amounts never receive it.
- The uninsured discount applies to an account whose financial class is self-pay at final bill and, on an insured account, to its non-covered-service liability postings priced under this rule; the coverage-terminated postings of an account whose financial class was corrected to self-pay after its final bill, and the observation-rate discount on observation-hour charge lines, are outside this sentence.

| Account | Uninsured discount on its non-covered-service postings |
|---|---|
| Insured, patient class that grants it, non-covered-service postings on file, no such adjustment yet | one adjustment, at the amount this rule fixes |
| Insured, patient class that does not grant it | none |
| Insured, adjustment already standing | none further |

## Posting the discount: `post_noncovered_line_discount_93cdc726`

**Capability.** The tool posts the uninsured discount on the non-covered amount an insurer released to the patient on one insured hospital account. One call books one discount adjustment of kind `UNINSURED_DISCOUNT` on the account, dated today and pointing back to the non-covered patient-liability posting it discounts, and lowers the account's patient balance by the amount given. The patient sees the discount on the account activity and a correspondingly lower balance.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `post_noncovered_line_discount_93cdc726` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the patient reference number of the account holder, as returned by the patient profile lookup | identifier |
| `encounter_id` | the hospital account (HAR) number of the account receiving the discount, as returned by the hospital-account lookup for this patient | identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the non-covered patient-liability posting being discounted, as shown in that account's activity list | identifier |
| `amount` | the discount in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation string with the adjustment reference (the new activity reference number), the account (hospital account number), the source (the liability posting discounted), the amount (USD, 2 decimal places), the posted date (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and the new balance (the account's patient balance after this discount, USD, 2 decimal places). A returned adjustment reference means the discount is on the account.
